name: Voice of Customer
tagline: A weekly digest of what customers actually said — verbatim quotes, counted shifts, account arcs — with a memory that spans weeks.
who: Founders and GTM teams who record customer calls but never mine them — and who want trends in the customer's words, not marketing language.
how: Drop call transcripts into the agent's workspace and it maintains one living digest: verbatim, fully attributed quotes grouped by theme in the customers' own words, week-over-week shifts with real counts (a trend word requires a number), and named account arcs a weekly snapshot structurally can't see. A quote registry prevents mis-attribution, a changelog carries the history, and on a weekly schedule the digest folds the new week in over itself. When the quote base grows, the agent offers a sortable, filterable dashboard app built on the same data.
